units.source_text: 好不伤心啊！”吟罢举袖拭泪。

en.t: How deeply sorrowful it is! After reciting this, she raised her sleeve and wiped away her tears.

units.source_text: 这位亲王相貌非常清秀，多年来勤于修行，

en.t: This prince had an exceptionally refined and handsome appearance, and for many years had devoted himself diligently to religious practice,

units.source_text: 体态略见瘦损，却反而更加高超优雅了。

en.t: so although his figure looked somewhat thinner, it only made him seem even more noble and elegant.

units.source_text: 为了便于照管两女孩，身穿家常便服，

en.t: To make it easier to look after the two girls, he wore plain everyday clothes,

units.source_text: 落拓不拘的姿态也很俊美，能令见者自感羞惭。

en.t: and even his relaxed, unconstrained bearing was so beautiful that anyone who saw him felt ashamed of themselves.

units.source_text: 大女公子从容不迫地把砚台移过来，像戏书一般在砚上写字。

en.t: The elder young lady calmly drew the inkstone toward herself and, as if writing in play, began to write on it.

units.source_text: 亲王给她一张纸，说道：“写在这上面！

en.t: The prince handed her a sheet of paper and said, Write on this.
It is not easy to write on an inkstone.

units.source_text: 大女公子腼腆地写一首诗：

en.t: The elder young lady shyly wrote a poem:
